svg.title: Layout of the metadata block
svg.desc: The metadata block to scale with part A and the two parts of part B, the byte layout of one record of each kind with real records as examples, and the timestamps of part B in record order, which show why the form changes at record 87,813.
svg.text: 5,164,151 B at the head of the coder stream, behind a stream header of 39 B: two records for each of the 243,425 pages
243,425 records in the order of the pages
Part B: 243,425 records sorted by revision id. Record k belongs to the page
with the k-th smallest revision id of part A, so the pairing needs no side information.

text.tspan: page id as a difference to the page before, revision id in four bytes

svg.text: record 0, the first page of the stream
record 71,148, the first page behind the redirect block; 2D is the minus sign

text.tspan: timestamp in six bytes of base 100

svg.text: year since 2001, day = month x 31 + day - 32

text.tspan: timestamp as the difference in seconds to the record before, decimal

svg.text: record 87,870 of part B, 28 June 2005; an address has no user id
address: 04, then two bytes per octet (81 = hex 51: 85 81)

text.tspan: Timestamps of part B in record order
In B1 the revision ids are not in time order, so each

svg.text: timestamp is written in full. In B2 the timestamps rise with the
revision id and the difference to the record before is short.

text.tspan: One byte per two decimal digits: 0x80 + value.
Only in the record where a name first appears.
1,013 records of part A carry them behind a tab.
In front of every record of part B a forecast of its timestamp

svg.text: in the same form is fed to the models. It is not coded.
